name: linear-gradient
summary: Linear gradient background from a direction name or an angle.

arguments.name: $direction
accepts: a direction name such as top or bottom-left

arguments.name: $colors
accepts: one or more colour stops: a colour, or a colour with one or two positions, such as (red 0 10%) (blue 10% 100%)
a position on its own between two colours, as a hint, such as (red, 30%, blue)
var() for a stop or the whole list
a word that is not a colour, a position first or last, two positions in a row, three positions in a stop and null are refused, because the gradient would be dropped
